technicalProfile: Junior Machine Learning Engineer specializing in model development, optimization, and edge AI deployment. Reduced mT5 SLM model size 5x (from 500MB to 100MB) via pruning, 8-bit LoRA, and INT8 quantization. Following computer vision experience, currently focusing on Natural Language Processing (NLP). Co-authored a research paper published in El-Cezeri Journal (2026). Developed Zettelkasten AI Notes (Pupilica AI Hackathon Top 10 Finalist), featuring a Two-Tier Vector RAG pool, CPU cross-encoder reranking, and Vulkan GPU local GGUF inference.

experiences.title: Machine Learning Intern
description: Developed an end-to-end industrial "Apple Detection and Quality Analysis System", integrating YOLOv8-seg instance segmentation, illumination-robust CIEDE2000 color difference formula, and physical dimension measurement with the industrial camera SDK into a PyQt5 desktop application.

Trained and deployed YOLOv8-seg models for real-time edge inference on resource-constrained embedded hardware, optimizing the image processing pipeline to eliminate data transfer bottlenecks and maintain continuous live stream processing.
Engineered data preprocessing and augmentation workflows for industrial camera feeds, conducting systematic model validation to ensure operational stability under challenging lighting conditions.

projects.title: mT5 Bidirectional EN-TR Machine Translation (ONNX INT8 & ORT Mobile)
projects.description: Fine-tuned an mT5-small model with 8-bit LoRA for bidirectional English-Turkish translation, achieving a 0.6245 METEOR score. Reduced model size 5x (from 500MB to 100MB) and optimized performance for resource-constrained environments by applying model pruning, ONNX compilation, and INT8 quantization for mobile deployment via ONNX Runtime (ORT Mobile).
projects.techStack: Python, PyTorch, Transformers, LoRA, Fine-Tuning, ONNX Runtime, NLP

projects.title: Zettelkasten AI Notes (Pupilica AI Hackathon — Top 10 Finalist)
projects.description: A privacy-first desktop knowledge management application implementing the Zettelkasten method using Python and Flet. Features a Dual AI Engine (Google Gemini and Vulkan-accelerated local GGUF models) with a Two-Tier In-Memory Vector RAG Pool, CPU cross-encoder reranking (Qwen3), and local embeddings (Harrier-0.6B) to synthesize atomic notes without duplicate concepts. Includes an interactive canvas mind map, live Markdown editor with LaTeX, smart WikiLinks, and SQLite WAL persistence.
projects.techStack: Python, Flet, SQLite, RAG, llama.cpp, Gemini API, NLP

projects.title: Arduino PC System Monitor
projects.description: A TinyML-powered system that monitors PC hardware resources (CPU, RAM, GPU, VRAM) and automatically optimizes power consumption. The system extracts hardware telemetry in real-time, executing an on-device SVM classification model on an Arduino Leonardo to determine and adjust the system's power state.
